Garib Newaz, Advocate instructed by Nurul Islam Bhuiyan, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioner

parties:
Zahirul Hoque Amin ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Hazi Md. Shah Alam Miah being dead his heirs (1)(a) Sakina Begum and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: IV. Because the High Court Division was wrong to hold that by the deed dated 06.06.1979, the defendants purchased 15 decimals of land of R.S. Khatian No. 1415 (Schedule-'Kha') from Mokbul Ahammod and the plaintiff as such has no right, title and possession over the suit land, inasmuch as Mokbul Ahammod and his two brothers are successors of Meher Ali, the owner of 8 annas of R.S. Khatian and the name of Mokbul Ahammod and his two brothers have also appeared in P.S. Khatian showing owner of 8 annas in the P.S. Khatian but in B.S. Khatian their names have appeared as owners of 16 annas of the entire land which is totally wrong and without any basis and the plaintiff prayed in the suit for declaring the B.S. record as wrong and collusive and on the other hand, the appellate Court clearly held that since Mokbul Ahammod and his brothers were owners of 8 annas share in the plot, so they cannot sell more land than their share and the defendants did not by their deed acquire, right and title more than the share of Mokbul Ahammod.
